content.comment_body: Today, I received my [company_name] [product_name] devices along with the [company_name] [product_name] engineering software. I expected to get a license key and download link, but only got a CD/DVD. Since it’s 2023 and I haven’t used any optical drives in years, and my MacBook Pro doesn’t have a CD/DVD drive, is there any option to download this software?
Unfortunately, volunteers in this forum cannot provide direct assistance. Please use the support request feature to contact [company_name]'s official support team for help.
There is currently no option to download the software online. The license is tied to the physical DVD. Many users have complained for years that distributing the software on CD/DVD is outdated.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated that [product_name] engineering software is still only available on CD/DVD in 2023, even though most modern devices lack optical drives. The absence of a digital download option makes it challenging for users with up-to-date hardware, leading to ongoing dissatisfaction with the reliance on physical media.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to receive a license key and the option to download the software online rather than being restricted to outdated physical media.
